top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire inspection report was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers did not provide  the correct ages of the children they were caring for when asked.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The sanitation report was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined caregiver does not have high school diploma or high school equivalent certificate.
